fixed: In the picture of what each choice gets you, the Cheat's dollar floated beside his hand; it is in his hand now. The Copycat's hand on his heart left his other arm out like a wing; he stands plainly, sorry on his face.

In the reveal the Cheat stood shoulder to shoulder with the teacher and pushed his dollar, and later his coffee, into her chest. The two fathers stand further back now and he holds his money out to her.
'into something you could buy' now moves in on the $3 FINE, JUST PAY half of the picture, instead of holding the same picture.
Weeks later she takes the fine down from the far side of the notice board, still facing the way she faced, after a fade.
notes: Every cut looked at large: nobody vanishes; the ending is the opening's place and size, the boy alone at the window.
